cur-fossil-yana.dateNote: In 2001 Vladimir Pitulko's team found spear shafts of woolly rhino horn and mammoth ivory by the Yana River in Arctic Siberia. They are about 32,000 years old (0.032 million years).
cur-fossil-yana.summary: Spear shafts of rhino horn show people lived in the Siberian Arctic 32,000 years ago.
